title: Tongue Fork #004 · 한국 30대 · 고혹적인 · 러시안 립 8단계 · 혀 20개 · 무게추 가운데 링 · 메이크업 뱀파이어 다크 5단계 · 배경 실내 창가 푸른 새벽빛 방
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Korean woman — Korean poised refined beauty light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone and real visible pores, mid 30s, long glossy dark-brown waves swept to one side, pushed to the absolute extreme: ghost-white skin, the eye sockets shadowed in deep black-red hollows, deeply carved hollow cheeks, fully opaque wet-glossy blood-black lips with a hard sculpted edge, vivid neon lime-green coloured contact lenses with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, a slow, lingering gaze, lips closed in a restrained knowing half-smile, an alluring, mature, magnetic expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): lips inflated to the final limit of what a living face could carry, a cartoon-doll mouth enlarged again and again: lips so tall and so plump that together they are taller than the entire lower half of her face, the lower lip an enormous glossy dome that covers her chin and hangs below the line of her jaw, the upper lip pressed against the base of her nose in a plump heart-shaped bow with two razor-sharp towering peaks, the mouth stretching almost as wide as her whole jaw, the pout projecting enormously far forward, much farther than the tip of her nose, like a huge sculpted doll mouth with a deep shadowed crease between the lips, so plump and taut that the lips seem to glow, every edge razor-crisp, so the lips are by far the only thing the eye sees on her face in this frontal view; mirror-glossy pink-nude with bright white highlights on both lips, perfectly symmetrical, still reading as a beautiful, believable human face, never duck-like, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a very steep, sharply sculpted surgical nose: a knife-like bridge that rises steeply and sharply from the brow, a needle-pointed tip projecting well forward, and very narrow, tightly pinched nostril wings with thin, slit-like nostrils; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her mouth is wide open and her tongue is stretched out as far as a real human tongue can reach, long and low with the two forked tips reaching down past the lower lip toward her chin, deeply forked like a snake's, split down the middle for most of its length, the two pointed tips clearly separated and curling apart, the whole length of the tongue from her lips to its tips clearly visible and in sharp focus (this overrides the lips pressed or closed in her expression).

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about seventy-three in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; two small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two straight bars across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; five small bar or rings through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit fourteen pieces above the lobe: seven classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, four studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and three in the conch and tragus; five small studs on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; eight small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are inspired by the sea: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are round pearl studs, tiny scallop-shell and starfish charms and rings strung with small coral beads. A forehead bead band: a row of large turquoise and coral beads is strung across the top of her forehead along the hairline like a headband, with a round ornament set with a large gem at its centre. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of this iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly nine separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear tarnished dark silver a hammer head on a shortest chain, blackened cast iron a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, dark patinated bronze a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a short chain, dull dark brass a teardrop-shaped sinker on a medium chain, dull pewter-grey tin a miniature anvil on a medium chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a square-sided cowbell on a long chain, dull blue-grey lead a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a longer chain, oxidized dark copper a cube-shaped block on a longer chain, blackened cast iron a ship's anchor on a longest chain; on the right ear dull pewter-grey tin a round bell on a shortest chain, dull dark brass a square-sided cowbell on a shortest chain, dull blue-grey lead a teardrop-shaped sinker on a short chain, blackened cast iron a cube-shaped block on a medium chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a miniature anvil on a medium chain, oxidized dark copper a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, dark patinated bronze a pyramid-shaped lump on a longer chain, tarnished dark silver a hammer head on a longer chain, dull pewter-grey tin a ship's anchor on a longest chain. On each ear the single iron ring carries all the weights, hanging in a staggered cluster on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because all the load is carried by one opening, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pale gold and silver set with white pearls, mother-of-pearl and pink coral, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes. In addition to all of the above, her tongue carries a very dense set of piercings in the same metal and gems: three straight barbells threaded sideways through the base of the tongue, evenly spaced above where the split begins, each bar hidden inside the tissue with only its two round end balls showing at the outer edges of the tongue; a separate barbell threaded sideways through each fork, its bar hidden inside the fork with only the two round balls showing on the side edges of the fork; a row of five barbell studs down the centre line of each fork, each with a ball on top and underneath; a ring through each pointed tip; and a row of three barbell studs down the centre of the undivided root of the tongue, the pieces spread along the tongue so that every one reads individually with bare pink tissue between them. her teeth carry a polished metal grill over all the upper and lower front teeth set with small gems, and metal-capped canine fangs; on her lips a Medusa stud above the upper lip, a labret stud under the lower lip, a snake-bite ring on each side of the lower lip, a row of three small rings along the lower lip's edge and a vertical ring through the centre of the lower lip. From a thick ring through the centre of the tongue, at the point where the split begins, a heavy chain hangs straight down over her lower lip and chin with blackened cast iron a barrel-shaped weight at its end, a massive, dense lump of rough, matte, unpolished metal at least as big as her whole fist, hanging freely in the air in front of her chin and neck, the weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones and never resting on her chest or body. The two forks of the tongue stay clearly apart: a wide clear gap of empty air separates them all the way from where the split begins down to the two pointed tips, which hang well apart and never touch, stick together or overlap, and nothing joins one fork to the other below the split. From the underside of each pointed tip of the tongue a thin, glistening strand of saliva falls straight down, the two strands hanging apart from each other and catching the light. In each dimple of her cheeks sits a small barbell stud with a gem on top, and from each stud a fine chain runs along the cheek, well below the eye and clear of the corner of the mouth, to the ear ring on the same side. From the labret stud under the lower lip a medium chain hangs down over the middle of the chin with rough-cast matte yellow gold a square-sided cowbell at its end, a dense lump of rough, matte, unpolished metal at least as big as her fist, resting against the skin of the chin and hanging behind the tongue chains, its lower edge no lower than the level of her collarbones. Fine chains link the lip pieces: a short chain runs from the Medusa stud above the upper lip, along the outside of the corner of the mouth, to the snake-bite ring on the same side, and a short chain runs from each snake-bite ring along the edge of the lower lip to the vertical ring at the centre of the lower lip.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it. Tongue piercing depth: every barbell on the tongue runs beneath the surface, its bar hidden inside the flesh so that only its two round end balls show on the surface, the pink tissue faintly raised over the hidden bar with a small warm shadow at each ball, and every stud and ring on the tongue passes through the real wet healthy tongue tissue, calm and healthy with no redness, no swelling and no irritation. Every ring that carries a chain passes through the real tissue, and the tongue stays stretched out at its full length with its two forks apart despite the weights. The chains lie against the skin of the cheeks and over the lower lip with a small warm shadow beneath them, each link clearly visible, and every chain ends at a ring or hoop rather than floating free.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: The background is a quiet room beside a tall window, with soft pale blue pre-dawn light and a cool blurred grey-blue wall behind her, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than her face so that her face and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
